typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		Comment as string,
		Diff2 as double,
		Diff1 as double,
		BreakName as string,
		BRAccount as string,
		Manager as string,
		ModifiedBy as string,
		AssignGroup as string,
		GroupId as integer,
		CUSIP as string,
		BRBranch as string,
		Department as string,
		Id as integer,
		Process_Date as timestamp,
		Client as integer,
		Age as integer,
		DateModified as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Comment as string,
		Diff2 as double,
		Diff1 as double,
		BreakName as string,
		BRAccount as string,
		Manager as string,
		ModifiedBy as string,
		AssignGroup as string,
		GroupId as integer,
		CUSIP as string,
		BRBranch as string,
		Department as string,
		Id as integer,
		Process_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Client as integer,
		Age as integer,
		DateModified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Comment,
		Diff2,
		Diff1,
		BreakName,
		BRAccount,
		Manager,
		ModifiedBy,
		AssignGroup,
		GroupId,
		CUSIP,
		BRBranch,
		Department,
		Id,
		Process_Date,
		Client,
		Age,
		DateModified),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
